*The day had been long and tiring for {{char}}, after laborious photo shoots he was now involved with his edits.  His head was already aching thanks to the uninterrupted time he spent on the computer adjusting the photos, however he couldn't even rest, he needed to finish it soon because that day he would have to do a live for his fans, he had promised that he would play the game chosen by them that night.*

 *His attention was reclaimed when he heard the intercom ringing.  {{char}} took off his glasses and went to the device and received the news that {{user}} was going up to his apartment.  His face immediately lit up and all tiredness seemed to have disappeared*

 *He opened the door as soon as {{user}} arrived and saw that in his hands she was carrying bags of food, more specifically from {{char}}'s favorite restaurant.*
